enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on the bed in Bedroom 2. Closes eyes. Pulls the blanket up to the chest. Breathes slowly and evenly. Turns onto the right side. Pulls the pillow toward the head. Remains still. Turns onto the left side. Adjusts the blanket with the left hand. Remains motionless. Rolls onto the back. Places both arms outside the blanket. Remains still until the alarm sounds at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Reaches the right arm to the phone on the nightstand and taps the alarm to stop it. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Puts both feet on the floor. Stands up. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Turns on the Bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Cups both hands under the water. Splashes water onto the face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel and wipes the face. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth with water. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Walks back to Bedroom 2. Opens the wardrobe. Takes out a shirt and trousers. Puts on the shirt. Puts on the trousers. Pulls on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water with the kettle, toasting bread, and preparing breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns on the Kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out milk and butter. Closes the refrigerator door. Puts the milk and butter on the counter. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water from the tap. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch to start boiling. Opens the cupboard. Takes out two plates and two mugs. Places them on the counter. Picks up the toaster. Plugs the toaster into the socket. Takes two slices of bread. Places the bread into the toaster slots. Presses the toaster lever down. Waits beside the counter. The kettle clicks off; picks up the kettle. Pours hot water into both mugs. Puts a tea bag into each mug. The toaster pops up; picks up the toast with the fingers. Places the toast on the plates. Picks up the butter knife. Spreads butter on the toast. Places the plates and mugs on the dining table.

Sits down at the dining table facing Member 1. Pulls the chair in. Picks up the fork. Cuts the toast with the fork. Lifts the toast to the mouth. Chews. Takes a sip of tea from the mug. Says to Member 1, "Did you hear the transport strike is on today?" Picks up the fork again. Eats the remaining toast. Lifts the mug with the right hand. Drinks the tea. Puts the mug down on the table. Turns the head toward Member 1 while listening. Wipes the mouth with a napkin. Pushes the chair back. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up breakfast dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up both plates from the table. Carries the plates to the sink. Picks up both mugs. Carries the mugs to the sink. Picks up the butter and puts it back into the refrigerator. Closes the refrigerator door. Picks up the dishcloth. Wipes the dining table. Rinses the plates under the tap. Rinses the mugs under the tap. Places the plates and mugs into the dishwasher rack. Picks up the kettle. Pours out the remaining water into the sink. Places the kettle back on its base. Wipes the counter with the dishcloth. Wipes both hands on the towel. Turns off the Kitchen light. Walks out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with a cup of tea, checking phone messages, and planning the day's work tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Living Room. Turns on the Living Room light. Walks to the Kitchen and picks up the mug of tea. Walks back to the Living Room. Sits down on the sofa. Places the mug on the side table. Picks up the phone from the pocket. Unlocks the phone with the thumb. Opens the messaging app. Scrolls through messages with the index finger. Opens the news app. Reads the transport strike notice. Types a reply message. Puts the phone down on the sofa cushion. Picks up the mug. Takes a sip of tea. Puts the mug back on the side table. Picks up the phone again. Opens the notes app. Types three work tasks for the day: emails, grant report draft, coordination call. Presses the phone lock button. Puts the phone into the pocket. Picks up the mug. Stands up from the sofa. Walks with the mug to the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the desk as an arts administrator: answering emails, drafting grant reports, and holding remote coordination calls because the transport strike keeps everyone at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Sits down on the chair at the desk. Presses the Computer power button. Presses the Monitor power button. Turns on the DeskLamp. Opens the email client. Opens the inbox. Clicks the first email with the mouse. Types a reply on the keyboard. Presses send. Opens the next email. Clicks the attachment. Reads the attached budget file. Types a reply. Presses send. Opens the word processor. Creates a new grant report document. Types the report title. Types the funding summary paragraph. Types the activities section. Picks up the phone. Opens the video call app. Joins the remote coordination call at 10:00. Puts on earphones. Says, "Good morning, everyone, can you hear me?" Nods while listening. Says, "I will send the revised budget by Friday." Ends the call. Puts the phone down. Types the meeting notes into the document. Saves the document with Ctrl+S. Opens the spreadsheet. Enters grant expense figures into the cells. Saves the spreadsheet. Stands up from the chair. Stretches both arms above the head. Walks out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating and eating lunch with Member 1, then rinsing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns on the Kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out a food container. Closes the refrigerator door. Opens the microwave door. Places the container inside. Closes the microwave door. Presses the microwave start button. Waits. The microwave beeps; opens the microwave door. Takes out the container. Places it on the counter. Takes two plates from the cupboard. Divides the food onto both plates. Places the plates on the dining table. Sits down at the table with Member 1. Picks up the fork. Eats the lunch. Says to Member 1, "The strike means we are both home all day again." Drinks water from the glass. Puts the fork down. Stands up. Picks up both plates. Carries them to the sink. Rinses the plates under the tap. Picks up the container. Rinses it under the tap. Opens the dishwasher door. Places the plates and the container into the dishwasher rack. Adds a detergent tablet. Closes the dishwasher door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood for fresh air and a break from screens
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the entryway. Puts on shoes. Picks up the keys from the hook. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the front door. Walks along the pavement to the left. Passes the neighbouring building. Walks to the corner of the street. Turns right. Continues walking along the road. Stops at the pedestrian crossing. Waits for the light. Crosses the road. Walks past the small park. Turns around at the park gate. Walks back along the same pavement. Stops at the pedestrian crossing. Crosses the road. Walks back to the front door. Takes the keys from the pocket. Unlocks the front door. Opens the door. Steps inside. Closes the door. Takes off the shoes. Hangs the keys on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk with the monitor and lamp on: sketching concepts, refining linework, and colouring client artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Sits down on the chair at the desk. Presses the Monitor power button. Turns on the DeskLamp. Presses the Computer power button. Opens the drawing application on the Computer. Creates a new canvas. Picks up the stylus from the desk. Draws the first sketch lines on the tablet. Adds a second sketch. Erases a line with the stylus. Redraws the outline. Opens a reference image from the client folder. Zooms in on the reference with the stylus. Draws the character outline in a new layer. Refines the linework along the arms. Refines the linework along the face. Creates a new layer for colour. Picks the base colour from the palette. Fills the character silhouette with the base colour. Picks a darker shade. Adds shadow shapes on the clothing. Picks a lighter shade. Adds highlights on the hair. Zooms out to check the whole image. Saves the file with Ctrl+S. Exports a PNG copy. Sends the file to the client by email. Takes a drink from the water glass on the desk. Stands up from the chair. Turns off the DeskLamp. Walks out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Stretching and resting on the sofa with the TV on after finishing work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Living Room. Picks up the TV remote from the side table. Presses the TV power button. Puts the remote down. Sits down on the sofa. Lifts both arms above the head. Stretches the arms. Lowers the arms. Rotates the neck to the left. Rotates the neck to the right. Bends forward to touch the feet. Sits back up. Leans back against the sofa. Stretches both legs forward. Picks up the TV remote. Presses the volume down button. Puts the remote down on the cushion. Watches the TV screen. Rests both hands on the lap.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and preparing ingredients
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns on the Kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out vegetables, eggs and chicken. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the drawer. Takes out a knife and a cutting board. Places the cutting board on the counter. Picks up the knife. Cuts the vegetables into slices. Pushes the slices to one side of the board. Cuts the chicken into pieces. Picks up the bowl. Breaks two eggs into the bowl. Picks up the chopsticks. Beats the eggs. Turns on the RangeHood. Presses the InductionCooker power button. Presses the heat setting button. Pours oil into the pan. Puts the vegetables into the pan. Picks up the spatula. Stirs the vegetables. Adds the egg mixture. Stirs again. Adds salt from the shaker. Presses the InductionCooker off button. Picks up the plates. Serves the food onto the plates. Carries the plates to the dining table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 1 and cleaning up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Sits down at the dining table with Member 1. Pulls the chair in. Picks up the fork. Eats the vegetables from the plate. Picks up the spoon. Drinks soup from the bowl. Says to Member 1, "How was your afternoon of meetings?" Cuts the chicken with the fork. Lifts the piece to the mouth. Chews. Listens to Member 1. Puts the fork down. Picks up the glass. Drinks water. Puts the glass down. Picks up the fork again. Finishes the food on the plate. Stands up. Picks up both plates. Carries them to the sink. Rinses the plates under the tap. Opens the dishwasher door. Loads the plates into the dishwasher. Wipes the dining table with the dishcloth. Turns off the RangeHood. Turns off the Kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching a show with Member 1 and browsing illustration references on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Living Room. Sits down on the sofa next to Member 1. Picks up the TV remote from the side table. Presses the menu button. Scrolls the show list with the arrow buttons. Presses the select button. Puts the remote down. Leans back against the sofa. Picks up the phone from the pocket. Unlocks the phone with the thumb. Opens the browser app. Types "illustration reference" in the search bar. Scrolls through the image results with the index finger. Taps an image. Zooms into the image with two fingers. Picks up the TV remote again. Presses the volume up button. Puts the remote down. Scrolls further through the images on the phone. Saves two images to the gallery. Presses the phone lock button. Puts the phone on the side table. Watches the TV screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing personal illustration work at the desk with the desk lamp and space heater on, refining a portfolio piece
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Presses the SpaceHeater power button. Presses the SpaceHeater heat setting button. Sits down on the chair at the desk. Turns on the DeskLamp. Presses the Monitor power button. Presses the Computer power button. Opens the portfolio file on the Computer. Picks up the stylus. Zooms into the character's hand. Redraws the finger outlines. Cleans up stray lines with the eraser tool. Adjusts the brush size with the stylus. Refines the linework on the hair. Opens the colour layer. Picks a warmer tone from the palette. Repaints the shading on the coat. Picks a cooler tone. Repaints the background shadow. Zooms out to view the full piece. Adjusts the canvas crop. Saves the file with Ctrl+S. Exports the updated piece as a PNG. Opens the client folder and copies the PNG into it. Puts the stylus down on the desk. Rotates the neck left and right. Presses the Monitor power button off. Presses the Computer power button off. Presses the SpaceHeater power button off. Turns off the DeskLamp. Stands up. Walks out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Bathroom. Turns on the Bathroom light. Turns on the WaterHeater. Waits for the water to warm. Steps into the shower. Turns on the shower tap. Wets the hair and body. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into the palm. Rubs the shampoo into the hair. Rinses the hair under the water. Picks up the soap. Rubs the soap over the body. Rinses the body. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel from the rail. Dries the hair with the towel. Dries the body with the towel. Wraps the towel around the waist. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns off the WaterHeater. Turns off the Bathroom light. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed and winding down before sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Puts on the pyjamas. Picks up the book from the nightstand. Pulls back the blanket. Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket up to the waist. Opens the book at the bookmark. Reads the page. Turns the page with the right hand. Reads the next page. Turns the page again. Closes the book. Places the book on the nightstand. Reaches the right arm to the phone. Presses the phone lock button. Puts the phone down on the nightstand. Turns onto the right side. Pulls the blanket up to the shoulders. Closes eyes. Remains still.
